step1_analysis.description: Two NMOS differential pairs, likely forming the switching quad of a mixer, phase detector, or frequency discriminator in a GMSK modulator.

paper_reference.title: A GMSK Modulator Using a Frequency Discriminator-Based Synthesizer

Voltage Gain.description: Low-frequency differential voltage gain of the pairs

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = sqrt(2 * unCox * W/L * Id) = sqrt(2 * 270u * 10 * 250u) = 36.7 mS. Gain = gm * Rload = 36.7m * 2k = 73.4 V/V = 37.3 dB
sky130_expected.reasoning: Assuming 500uA tail current and 2kOhm load resistors, the gain matches the paper's reported 36 dB.

sky130_expected.calculation: f_3dB = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * Cload). With Rload=2k and Cload~15fF (parasitics), f_3dB ~ 5.3 GHz
sky130_expected.reasoning: Bandwidth is limited by the RC time constant at the output nodes. Sky130 130nm process is faster than 0.8um, so BW should easily exceed the 2.5 GHz operating frequency.

Power Consumption.description: DC power consumed by the differential pairs

sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper's 75mW is for the entire synthesizer chip. The isolated dual differential pair consumes a fraction of that, estimated at 1.8mW based on typical biasing.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure AC gain, bandwidth, transient response, and DC power of the dual differential pair.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Dual Differential Pair Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u

XM1 N1 IN N3 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 IN_BAR N3 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM4 N8 N5 N10 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM3 N9 N7 N10 VEE sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}

VDD VDD 0 1.8
VEE VEE 0 0

* Tail currents
I1 N3 VEE 500u
I2 N10 VEE 500u

* Loads
R1 VDD N1 2k
R2 VDD N2 2k
R3 VDD N8 2k
R4 VDD N9 2k

* Inputs
VIN IN 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.001 10MEG 0 0)
VIN_BAR IN_BAR 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 SIN(0.9 -0.001 10MEG 0 0)
VN5 N5 0 DC 0.9 AC 1 SIN(0.9 0.001 10MEG 0 0)
VN7 N7 0 DC 0.9 AC -1 SIN(0.9 -0.001 10MEG 0 0)

.control
op
let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print power

ac dec 100 1k 10G
let out_diff1 = v(N1) - v(N2)
let gain_db1 = 20 * log10(mag(out_diff1))
meas ac gain_1mhz find gain_db1 at=1MEG
meas ac bw1 when gain_db1 = 34 fall=1

tran 1n 200n
meas tran vpp_out1 pp v(N1)
meas tran vpp_out2 pp v(N8)
quit
.endc
